read_tag_from_buffer: read a protocol buffer tag from a memoryview buffer at a given position and return the raw tag bytes
skip_field_by_tag: skip a protocol buffer field in a serialized message by looking up its wire type from the tag bytes
decode_unknown_field_set: decode an UnknownFieldSet from a serialized protocol buffer buffer starting at a given position
decode_unknown_field: decode a single unknown protocol buffer field by wire type and return the raw data and new position
create_varint_decoder: create a varint decoder function that decodes variable-length integers from a buffer with a given bit mask
